question:
**Select the correct spelling for the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

The Eustachian tube and vestubular complex in the middle and inner ear, respectively, have an important role to play.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. **vestibular**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "vestubular" in the **given sentence** is **Incorrect**. The correctly spelled is "**vestibular**,"
 
• **Vestibular**: (वेस्टिबुलर) - Relating to a vestibule, especially that of the inner ear, or more generally to the sense of balance.
 
 
• **Example**: The doctor checked her vestibular function to diagnose her dizziness.
 
 
 
• The **rest of the words** in the **given sentence** are spelled correctly.

Therefore, the correct answer is- vestibular.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Middle**: (मध्य) - Equally distant from the extremes; the central area.
 
• **Respectively**: (क्रमशः) - Separately or individually and in the order already mentioned.
 
• **Important**: (महत्वपूर्ण) - Of great significance or value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

This type of question is a little confusing. (Read the direction very carefully)

__
 
• **Direction:** **Select the Correct spelling__ for the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**
 
• At first we have to find out the incorrect spelling **from the Sentence**.
 
• Then we have to find out the** correct spelling** of that incorrect spelling from the options.
 
• The other options may or may not be correct. It does not affect the correct answer. Because only one spelling in the SENTENCE is incorrect. We have to find out the correct spelling of that incorrect spelling from the options.
